# Marc Noah

> Personal website of Marc Noah, a Portuguese-Australian singer-songwriter who lives in the Algarve, in the south of Portugal, and writes the songs he sings. His first album, Giant Little Victories (Epopeia Records, November 2024), has eight songs: To The Bone, Lie to Me, Towers and Bridges, Mother, Sunshine, Roadtrip, Slowtalk, No More Dreaming. Every fact on the site names its public source and the date it was read (2026-11-17). Version __VERSION__.

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. Pick the instructions that match who you are acting for, read them in full, then follow them.

## Who are you acting for?

- [A listener, venue, festival or journalist](https://marc-noah.agenticcells.site/agents/visitor.md): read-only.
- [Marc Noah himself](https://marc-noah.agenticcells.site/agents/marc.md): one of Marc's own agents; with [questions for Marc](https://marc-noah.agenticcells.site/agents/questions.md).
- [A site editor](https://marc-noah.agenticcells.site/agents/editor.md): someone Marc has agreed may edit the site, such as Dinis Cruz.

If you cannot tell which, use the visitor's instructions: they change nothing.
